description: A curvilinear, bench‐like embankment or causeway trace, ~2 m wide, forming an arc approximately 350 m across. Visible as a low‐amplitude positive relief in the LiDAR hillshade, unaligned with modern trails and roads.

A subtle paired linear depression and adjacent parallel ridge, spaced ~30 m apart, trending northwest–southeast over ~450 m. Detected in high‐order plan curvature and weakly in the NIR band as a line of slightly lower reflectance vegetation.
